notes: Author tests custom all-reduce acquire/release fences: ~1–3 us latency versus no-fence; 6 us using TensorRT-LLM-style fences. Optimization/design discussion, no confirmed deployed fix.
Asks how to measure speculative-decoding cost coefficient; Nsight Systems profiles draft and target model times, but no observed serving regression is reported.

L4 prefix-caching warmup: block manager v2 24.06 s versus v1 14.58 s. cProfile pointed at the model runner but the reporter called it a mystery; the cause came from inspecting computed_block_nums (prefix-cache blocks not marked computed in v2). PR #7822 'Closes #7619', merged, and closed the issue. Reporter comaniac is a core maintainer (CCs the team, closed the issue).
Links to a Colab notebook/repository without any specific measured inference or serving performance complaint.

Prefix caching did speed up (cost time 2.98 s without versus 0.17 s with); the reporter was confused that the gain showed up in sample time rather than model execution. Reporter later explained async CUDA execution made time.perf_counter() misleading (use CUDA events). The reporter closed it; the bot only added the stale label. Could arguably be excluded as usage_question.
Full CUDA graph capture/profiler visibility question, not a demonstrated performance regression; responder explicitly asks what actual regression exists and requests DEBUG logs.
Asks where to find reasoning-model performance measurements, without reporting an observed slowdown.

Multi-turn APC on Llama-2-7B, single A100 40GB: 35.29 s without caching versus 35.61 s with it. Maintainer explains the workload is decode-dominated, with too little shared prefill to benefit. A separate second-turn spike was traced to first-time Triton JIT, avoided with FlashAttention. Reporter hmellor is a vLLM MEMBER.
Question about differing file/line versions between pip and Docker installations; mentions a bug but no serving performance shortfall.
Asks for benchmark settings behind FP8 documentation speedup claim (1.6x), rather than reporting a regression.
CPU FP8 MoE expert implementation measured about 45% higher per-expert latency than reporter’s own implementation at batch sizes 1/2/4/8; no reply establishes cause; stale bot closure.
Asks whether FlashAttention-2 works on V100; no measured performance deficit.
Asks to optimize prefix-cache block accounting with MTP enabled; reports cache hit-block behavior, but no inference speed, stall, or memory-capacity shortfall.

Qwen3-32B-FP8 with speculative Qwen3 drafts slowed from 20-21 to 10-11 tok/s on two L20s; reporter tested multiple drafts and speculative-token counts. Reporter quotes DeepSeek and suspects transfer overhead; others suggest acceptance rate. Cause unconfirmed; bot closed it.

EAGLE on Llama-3.1-70B using 4x H100 falls short of paper speedups. Users found the vLLM EAGLE draft model differs from the reference (extra input/output norms, missing residual); PR #11672 (merged) raised acceptance rate from 0.13 to 0.57. The thread does not show the full speedup gap closing; bot closed it. Reporter speaks for the team ('We are in the process of...') but author_association is CONTRIBUTOR, so maintainer status is unclear.
2x B200: concurrency 1 gives 35.04 tok/s, 8.29 s E2E versus concurrency 16 at 49.97 tok/s, 5.99 s. Batching/scheduling conjectured only; no maintainer investigation; stale closure.
100 concurrent Qwen2.5 requests: vLLM 0.6.3 avg ~19–20 s versus 0.5.1 ~13 s; PyTorch/Transformers versions also change, so not isolated; stale closure.

With pipeline parallel serving across two NVLink-connected A40s, reporter says NVLink appears unused and throughput falls markedly; no quantitative benchmark results or cause resolution; stale closure.
On one A100, Medusa is faster at concurrency 1 (577 versus 785 s) but slower at concurrency 2 (367 versus 335 s) and higher; ~50% acceptance reported; no causal reply; stale closure.

Beam search repeatedly concatenates candidate sequences in a Python loop; author times the operation and proposes top-k before concatenation (~40% less time). A commenter says PR #19347 was merged; the bot closed the issue anyway.

Multi-node 2x8 H100 TP8/PP2: v0.11.0 healthy, v0.12.0-0.17.1 CPU saturates and throughput declines (no throughput numbers given). Another user's top output shows ~70% system CPU and Ray workers above 2200%. Busy-wait only a hypothesis; bot closed it. A spam comment with a payment link was ignored.

Reporter could not reproduce the EPD disaggregation speedup from the vLLM blog. Another user posted 4x A6000 tables where DP=4 beat EPD. An EPD PR author reproduced the blog gains on v0.11.1 and explained that in v0.14.1 the baseline improved, narrowing the gap, with CPU contention adding variance. Bot closed it afterwards; expected_behavior versus stale_unresolved is a judgement call.
Single A6000 with 70B AWQ long context: ~15 s TTFT at 16K (also vLLM); maintainer says SGLang primarily optimized decode, prefill improvements pending; requested reproduction and client demo.
GLM-5 GB200 functional-support and performance-optimization tracker; not a user performance-incident report.
Feature integration for fusing shared and sparse experts in DSV4 MegaMoE, completed via PR #39313; no observed serving regression.

On 8x H100, Llama4-Scout throughput regressed between Nov 24 and Nov 27 nightly images (5250 to 486 tok/s at concurrency 128). A collaborator isolated FA3 via bench_one_batch and posted timeline screenshots (tool not named) showing a CPU gap between ops. Fix PR #15009 'Fix regression caused by fa3 block_table' is merged. Reporter is a COLLABORATOR, so maintainer status is unclear.
32B model on eight V100s fails at startup with OOM or no cache blocks for different gpu_memory_utilization; failure to initialize, not a reported slow/stalled serving run.

Single L20: Qwen2-7B FP8 falls from 59.41 tok/s at v0.5.0 to 26.50 at v0.5.1; FP16 remains ~44. Maintainer requests benchmark script/CUDA build details. PR #6384 (merged) turns off CUTLASS scaled_mm on Ada Lovelace and is stated to resolve it.

Maintainer documents that TP=8 all-reduce activation memory is not reused across layers, unlike TP=1, using a memory allocation visualization. PR #2151 'Fixes #2150', merged, closed the issue; it cut peak memory from 25.5 to 19.5 GiB for Llama-70B TP=8.

8x A100: v0.5.0 model startup much slower than v0.4.2, with GPU P2P access cache generation taking ~8m50s (logs; nvitop also used). Maintainer linked PR #5528; another user measured it cutting that step to 44s; PR merged and issue closed.
